versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the boat-daily-check skill.
- Fetches real-time battery, solar, inverter, and alarm data from Victron VRM API for multiple installations.
- Generates beautiful, mobile-friendly HTML email reports each morning.
- Includes configurable report generation, CSV/JSON exports, and easy integration with OpenClaw cron jobs.
- Provides step-by-step setup instructions and troubleshooting tips.
